packages.label: חָכְמָה עִלָּאָה וְהַצַּדִּיק — אֶבֶן שְׁתִיָּה
packages.label_en: Supernal Wisdom and the Tzaddik — the Foundation Stone
packages.reason: The largest connected component in Torah #61 centers on קָדְשֵׁי קֳדָשִׁים (the Holy of Holies) as the hub connecting four parallel aspects of the same supreme reality: חָכְמָה עִלָּאָה (supernal wisdom), צַּדִּיק הַדּוֹר (the tzaddik of the generation), שֵֹּכֶל הָעֶלְיוֹן (the supernal intellect), and אֶבֶן שְׁתִיָּה (the foundation stone). All are bechina of the same essential domain: the all-encompassing divine intellect that is the root of all creation, the source from which all sweetening of judgments flows, and the cosmic locus to which all souls return on Rosh Hashanah. לוּחוֹת הָאֶבֶן (the stone tablets) are also a bechina of חָכְמָה עִלָּאָה — the tablets receive from the foundation stone. Three isolated pairs are merged into this package on the basis of shared essential nature: (1) נְּפָשׁוֹת / אֲבָנִים — souls are 'stones,' sharing the 'stone' bechina with the foundation stone itself; (2) נֶּפֶשׁ / נֵר — the individual soul is a candle, the light-unit that when gathered with others forms the collective אוֹר צַדִּיקִים; (3) עֵזֶר וְהַיְשׁוּעָה / הַמְתָּקַת הַדִּינִים — salvation and the sweetening of judgments share the same essential nature as the outcome-function of this entire domain. The teaching states: 'יִשְׁלַח עֶזְרְךָ מִקֹּדֶשׁ — הַיְנוּ עַל-יְדֵי הַשֵּׂכֶל שֶׁנִּקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ'; salvation itself IS the holy intellect in its redemptive expression. All twelve nodes share one essential nature: the divine intellectual root that sustains creation, resides in the tzaddik, receives the souls, and sweetens all strict judgment.

merge_notes.reason: Souls are explicitly called 'stones' (אֲבָנִים) via the verse 'תִּשְׁתַּפֵּכְנָה אַבְנֵי קֹדֶשׁ' (Eikhah 4:1). The bechina connection to Package 1 is direct and structural: the souls (= stones) come to the tzaddik who IS the אֶבֶן שְׁתִיָּה (= foundation stone) and are included within him. 'Stone' is the shared essential nature of both נְּפָשׁוֹת and the אֶבֶן שְׁתִיָּה cluster.

The individual soul IS a candle: 'נֵר ה' נִשְׁמַת אָדָם' (Mishlei 20). This is a description of the soul's essential nature as a light-unit — the same domain as נְּפָשׁוֹת / אֲבָנִים (both describe what a soul fundamentally IS). The candle-soul joins the stone-soul in the same Package 1 domain of 'the nature and gathering of souls before the tzaddik.'

The text states: 'עִקַּר הָעֵזֶר וְהַיְשׁוּעָה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הַמְתָּקַת הַדִּינִים, הוּא מִקֹּדֶשׁ, הַיְנוּ עַל-יְדֵי הַשֵּׂכֶל שֶׁנִּקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ' (Section ו). Salvation and the sweetening of judgments share their essential nature with קֹדֶשׁ / שֵׂכֶל — they are the concrete expression of what the holy intellect (Package 1) IS and DOES. They are not an effect produced by Package 1 (eitza) but are the same reality described from the perspective of the recipient.

packages.label: מִשְׁפַּט אֱמֶת וֶאֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים
packages.label_en: True Judgment and Faith in the Sages
packages.reason: This package groups all nodes in Torah #61 belonging to the domain of upright, balanced, uncorrupted judgment and the faith in sages that enables it. The bechina-pair {מִשְׁפָּט / דֶּרֶךְ הַמְמֻצָּע} establishes that justice/judgment IS the middle path (עַמּוּדָא דְּאֶמְצָעִיתָא) — it does not lean right or left, it is perfect balance. The pair {אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים / 'לֹא תָּסוּר...'} establishes that faith in the sages IS the biblical commandment of non-deviation — same essential quality: receiving from authoritative wisdom without personal distortion. The pair {מִשְׁפְּטֵי הַנְהָגוֹת יְשָׁרוֹת / מִשְׁפְּטֵי אֱמֶת} establishes that upright behavioral guidance IS true judgment. All six nodes share the same domain: the quality of uncorrupted, balanced reception of divine wisdom expressed as righteous leadership. This is the positive, holy pole of the teaching's central axis.
nodes: "לא תסור מן הדבר אשר יגידו לך ימין ושמאל"

merged_nodes: "לא תסור מן הדבר אשר יגידו לך ימין ושמאל"
merge_notes.reason: The Torah explicitly states אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים IS the commandment 'לֹא תָּסוּר מִן הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יַגִּידוּ לְךָ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאל' (Devarim 17:11). This pair defines the same essential quality — faithful non-deviation from the sages' teaching — which is itself the precondition for משפט (true judgment). They belong together as the 'faith' side of the judgment cluster.

Upright behavioral guidance and true judgment are the same reality: 'מִשְׁפְּטֵי הַנְהָגוֹת יְשָׁרוֹת, בִּבְחִינַת מִשְׁפְּטֵי אֱמֶת.' Both describe the product of uncorrupted reception of wisdom. They name the same quality from two perspectives (practical/behavioral vs. ontological/judicial) and belong in the judgment package.

packages.label: מוֹתָרוֹת וּמִשְׁפָּט מְעֻקָּל
packages.reason: This package groups the evil/negative domain of Torah #61: the corruption of the mind and judgment through physical excess, and its downstream effects. The bechina-pair {עֲצִירוּת / מוֹתָרוֹת} establishes that internal blockage/constipation IS excess-waste — they describe the same evil quality: what is retained when proper flow is absent, the spiritual/physical impurity that clogs the body. The pair {'מִשְׁפָּטִים בַּל יְדָעוּם' / מִשְׁפָּט מְעֻקָּל} establishes that the 'judgments they do not know' IS distorted/bent judgment — both name the same evil: judgment corrupted by the toxic smoke (עֲשָׁנִים סְרוּחִים) of the waste rising to the brain. The pair {עֵצוֹת נִבְעָרוֹת / עֲצַת נָשִׁים} establishes that foolish counsel IS the 'women's counsel' (the kind spoken in the toilet, according to Gittin 45) — both name debased, corrupt counsel that emerges from a heart made impure by the filth of excess. These three pairs mirror the three positive expressions in Package 2: faith in sages (Package 2) vs. damage to faith in sages (this package); true judgment (Package 2) vs. distorted judgment (this package); upright guidance (Package 2) vs. foolish counsel (this package).

merge_notes.reason: The Psalmist's phrase 'מִשְׁפָּטִים בַּל יְדָעוּם' is equated by the Rebbe with the result of confused/clouded intellect — 'בִּלְבּוּל הַמּוֹחִין' — which is itself bent judgment (מִשְׁפָּט מְעֻקָּל). Both nodes name the same evil: judgment so corrupted it can no longer be recognized as judgment. They are the evil mirror of Package 2's {מִשְׁפָּט / דֶּרֶךְ הַמְמֻצָּע}.

Foolish/bestial counsel IS the kind of counsel made in the toilet — both describe the same quality of corrupt advice that flows from a spiritually-degraded heart. The Rebbe explains that the heart of the person defiled by מוֹתָרוֹת becomes like a toilet, 'שֶׁשָּׁם כָּל עֲצָתָם.' This pair belongs squarely in the evil domain alongside מוֹתָרוֹת and מִשְׁפָּט מְעֻקָּל.

packages.label: מַחֲלֹקֶת וְסֵפֶר
packages.reason: This package groups the domain of halakhic controversy as the purifying mechanism that produces Torah literature and restores faith in the sages. The bechina-pair {מַחֲלֹקֶת / אֵלּוּ הַמַּיִם} establishes that controversy IS the purifying water (מֵי מְרִיבָה) — not destructive but cleansing, turning the accumulated impurity of Package 3 into spiritual purity. The pair {סֵפֶר / שְׁאֵלוֹת וּתְשׁוּבוֹת} establishes that a book (of Torah) IS a collection of questions and answers — the product of controversy processed through teshuvah. Together these four nodes define one essential domain: controversy as the instrument of purification and creative Torah renewal. The teaching's logic: מַחֲלֹקֶת (= purifying water) forces teshuvah, which generates ספרים (= שאלות ותשובות), which complete the Torah, which allows Torah to receive from חָכְמָה עִלָּאָה (Package 1), which sweetens all דינים. This is the process-package — the mechanism that links the fallen state (Package 3) back to the supreme domain (Package 1).

merge_notes.reason: A Torah book IS a collection of questions and responses: 'כִּי מִכָּל מַחֲלֹקֶת נַעֲשֶׂה סֵפֶר, בְּחִינַת שְׁאֵלוֹת וּתְשׁוּבוֹת.' The ספר = שאלות ותשובות pair shares the same essential domain as {מַחֲלֹקֶת / אֵלּוּ הַמַּיִם}: the controversy-and-response process that generates Torah renewal. Both pairs are expressions of the same transformation process.
